title: hygroryza ciliata
intro: Hygroryza ciliata, commonly known as the hairy vetch, is a type of legume plant that belongs to the family Fabaceae. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hygroryza ciliata include its potential to reduce blood pressure, prevent cardiovascular disease, and exhibit antibacterial and antifungal activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
